lines.text: On the Sabbath at a leading Pharisee's house, Jesus healed a man with dropsy and sent him away.
Jesus asked which of them would not pull a son or ox out of a pit on the Sabbath, and they could not answer.
Jesus taught that invited guests should sit in the last place at a funeral banquet so the host would move them up.
Jesus told the host to invite the poor, the crippled, the lame and the blind, and he would be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous.
After the invited guests made excuses, the angry master sent his servant to the temple courts to bring in the poor, crippled, blind and lame.
